proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Racial and Gender Pay Gaps
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on unadjusted median and adjusted pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks, omitting proprietary information and litigation strategy.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Amend Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board amend proxy access so shareholders may combine shares to equal 3% ownership without the 20-shareholder aggregation limit.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Risks of State Policies Restricting Reproductive Health Care
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on known and potential risks and costs to the Company from state policies restricting reproductive health care, and mitigation strategies.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Civil Rights and Non-Discrimination Audit and Report
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audit of the Company's impacts on civil rights and non-discrimination and their effect on the business, with a publicly disclosed report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Risks from Worker Misclassification by Certain Company Vendors
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Teamsters, on behalf of the International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on financial, reputational, and human rights risks from supply chain and distribution vendors that misclassify workers as independent contractors.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal.
